This is the first collaborator review of this PR. The PR changes toolpath generation (an open 2D Contour now accepts a start pick). Thus this review uses the SAFETY tier.

### What looks good

- `contour_along_chain` accepts only a start pick that is exactly equal to the climb-selected endpoint (`pts[0]` for climb, the last point for conventional). The pick does not reverse, trim or move the run. Thus an accepted pick always gives the same moves as the automatic run. This cannot make a new toolpath shape.
- `pts.len() < 2` is refused before the new index, so `pts[pts.len() - 1]` cannot panic.
- Each caller that passes an offset ride keeps a named refusal before the call:
  - the part wrapper (`open_run_ride`, also with no material),
  - the stock wrapper (`contour_open_run_sided`),
  - the open machining boundary (`contour_open.rs`, before the avoid dispatch).
- The avoid route (`contour_along_chain_avoid`) with a non-empty "Do not touch" set still refuses all start picks. Its empty set delegates to the wrappers above, which refuse first.
- In the sketch route, an open chain is always the centerline: `contour_sketch_pick.rs:229-240` refuses a side override and a non-Auto side on an open chain. `eff_climb` is `op_climb ^ reverse`, so the per-chain reverse selects the endpoint.
- A start pick with an open chain and more than one sketch chain is refused by name. My mutation shows that, without this guard, the one pick goes to all chains.
- The new app tests join the existing binaries `area_open` and `contour_dxf_sketch` through `#[path]` modules. No new top-level test binary.
- Each new test file has a provenance line and a Gate map line. The decision file `docs/decisions/1473-open-chain-end-picks.md` records the choice, the reason and the dropped options.
- No golden, snapshot, process file, manifest or lock change. No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` outside tests. All touched files stay under 400 lines.

### Results merged with main (built locally)

Built and run locally on macOS (Apple silicon, 12 gate jobs), in a trial merge of the head with `upstream/main` `2394b5ad1efc573b7b99a898a02cc4225b4d9893`. The head already contains that main: the merge is a no-op.

- Quick gate `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 101 of 101 steps passed. I ran it in five `--only` groups: motion build and 12 motion suites, app build, then 87 app suites. 0 failed, 0 stalled.
- The pins of the PR, by name:
  - `camcraft-motion --lib`: 6 tests (`natural_end`, `exact_natural_end`, `unproved_source`, short leg). All pass.
  - `camcraft-app --test area_open`: 12 passed.
  - `camcraft-app --test contour_dxf_sketch`: 7 passed (3 new `start_point::*`).
  - `camcraft-app --test contour_start_point`: 11 passed.
- Example catalog suites, full binaries:
  - `example_catalog`: 50 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored (existing).
  - `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed.
  - `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.
- Light lane `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main`: 4 of 4 steps passed (release build, `motion light: lib`, `motion light: adaptive2d`, `app light: pocket_pass_start`).
- Clippy: `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`. Both are clean.
- Heavy lanes: not run. This is a P2 PR, and AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review" gives it no heavy step.

Extra suites run: none were owed. The diff does not change `testdata/` or a fixture directory. It does not touch importer code.

Goldens moved: none. No recorded program (`*.nc`, `*.cl`, `examples/catalog/**`) changed.

### Mutations (SAFETY tier)

I applied each mutation in the review worktree only, ran the pins, and then restored the tree to the PR head.

1. `contour_chain.rs`: flip the climb endpoint choice (`!p.climb`). Red: `an_open_chain_accepts_a_start_pick_at_its_natural_end`, `a_natural_end_pick_keeps_the_lead_on_every_level`, `an_open_chain_refuses_starts_other_than_its_exact_natural_end`, `an_open_sketch_endpoint_pick_preserves_climb_and_chain_reverse`, `an_open_sketch_start_pick_follows_the_existing_wcs_yaw_mapping`.
2. `contour_run_stock.rs`: remove the stock wrapper refusal. Red, alone: `an_offset_stock_run_refuses_unproved_source_start_picks` (`contour_run_stock_tests.rs:97`).
3. `contour_sketch.rs`: remove the one-chain guard. Red, alone: `an_open_sketch_start_pick_requires_one_selected_chain` (`start_point.rs:64`).

All pins went green again after the restore.

### Requested before merge

None.

### Notes (not blocking)

- The pick must be bit-exact equal to the transformed sample endpoint. A pose with a different float path for the pick and the chain gives a refusal, not a wrong path. That is the safe side. The yaw pin covers a 90 degree WCS rotation.
- The PR has the label `P2`. The AGENTS.md table gives `P2` to a broken main or a regression. A legal pick that is refused is closer to `P3`. The maintainer can adjust the label. This does not change the review.
- The body ends with `Refs #1473`. This is correct: the PR does item 5 in part, and #1473 stays open.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
